title: SMS send queue with retry, templates, and status breakdown

mockup_description.layout: Dedicated 'File d'envoi SMS' page, distinct from a generic communication log.
key_elements: 'Mode simulation' banner: 'Les SMS sont enregistrés et simulés. Aucun envoi réel n'est effectué.' -- matches this app's real convention exactly
4 KPI cards: En file (28), Journalisés (156), Échecs (3), Relancés (7 -- auto-retried)

Queue table: Événement de présence (icon+label: Arrivée en retard/Absence/Départ anticipé), Élève, Téléphone du responsable, Aperçu du message, Type de déclencheur, Statut de file (En file/Journalisé/Échec/Relancé), Journalisé le, Relances count
'Modèle de message actuel' side panel: editable template with named variables ({{studentName}}, {{absenceType}}, {{absenceDate}}, {{schoolName}}), 'Modifier' button
'Statut de la file' donut chart: En file/Journalisé/Échec/Relancé breakdown + total
interactions: Failed sends automatically retry ('Relancé') a bounded number of times -- a real queue/retry mechanic, not just fire-and-forget

what_matches: The 'Mode simulation' framing is EXACTLY this app's real, established convention -- every SMS-adjacent feature built this session (absence SMS, missing-register reminder SMS) writes a real smsMessages row with status:'sent' immediately, and every UI surface says so explicitly

Attendance-related SMS (absence-on-mark, missing-register reminder) both land in the real, pre-existing smsMessages table and are visible in the existing /dashboard/communication/reminders send-log page
smsTemplates table already exists in schema (tenant-scoped name+body) -- the data model for a template system is already there, just not exposed with variable substitution UI
what_differs: This session's attendance SMS writes body text inline (hardcoded French sentence with values already interpolated) rather than through a template+variables system -- smsTemplates exists but isn't used by the attendance flows
smsMessages.status enum is only queued/sent/failed with no 'retried N times' counter or automatic retry logic -- every send in this app is immediate and one-shot
No dedicated attendance-specific SMS queue view -- the existing communication log is generic (all SMS sources mixed together), not filtered/grouped by triggering attendance event type
No status donut chart anywhere in the communication module

missing_to_add.item: Wire the attendance SMS sends (absence notification, missing-register reminder) through smsTemplates with {{variable}} substitution instead of inline string interpolation
missing_to_add.notes: Schema already supports it -- this is a refactor of existing working code, not new capability.

missing_to_add.item: Retry/relance mechanic: bounded auto-retry on status='failed', with a retryCount column on smsMessages
missing_to_add.notes: Since sends are simulated (never actually fail from a real carrier), 'failed' status would need an artificial failure condition (e.g. no phone number) to ever occur -- lower real value than it appears in the mockup.

missing_to_add.item: Attendance-filtered view of the SMS log (filter existing /dashboard/communication/reminders by a 'triggered by attendance' flag, or add a dedicated tab)
